name: Lentil Bulgur Pilaf
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: ¼ cup (50 g) brown lentils, rinsed
Salt, black pepper and lemon juice
steps: Simmer the lentils in 1½ cups water for 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook half the onion slowly in the oil for 12 minutes until deeply golden; set aside for topping.
Add the remaining onion, cumin and coriander to the pot with the lentils, then the bulgur and salt.
Cover and simmer on low for 12 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Rest 5 minutes. Top with the golden onion and a squeeze of lemon.
note: A simple Middle Eastern combination; lentils and grain together give a complete protein.
